title: The Mixtape of Lake Minnow
premise: In the dying mill town of Lake Minnow, seventeen-year-old Odile Dravenmoor keeps her head down—until a group chat called The Mixtape starts sending her songs that predict disasters hours before they happen. Tracing the messages to a burner phone hidden in the school's sealed 1998 time capsule, she uncovers evidence that the school board knowingly covered up contaminated water that sickened students for decades. When her best friend becomes the next predicted casualty and the board moves to destroy the capsule permanently, Odile must choose between staying safe and going public. She broadcasts the truth at the spring festival, saving her friend but burning every bridge in town—and finally letting herself be seen.
about_author: Dominic Montrose is the pen name of a former small-town newspaper reporter who spent three years covering school board scandals before turning to fiction. They write stories about queer kids who refuse to disappear quietly.

chapters.title: Track One: Static
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. A quiet senior year shatters when an unknown number adds her to 'The Mixtape,' sending a song minutes before a water tower collapses on Route 9. No one believes her warning except Theo, her closeted best friend. The emotional beat is dread wrapped in isolation—the first crack in her carefully maintained invisibility.

chapters.title: Side B: The Buried Years
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Following lyrics that reference the class of 1998, she and Theo break into the school annex and find the time capsule: a phone, water test results, and letters from sickened students the board silenced. She realizes the predictions are someone continuing the dead students' warnings. The beat shifts from fear to furious purpose.

chapters.title: Skip to the Chorus
chapters.summary: Alternating Odile and Theo POV. The Mixtape sends its darkest track yet—a song Theo recognizes as his own favorite, timestamped for Friday. Meanwhile the board chair announces the annex demolition, and Odile discovers the sender is the terminally ill daughter of a former board member, atoning for her father. The beat is desperation racing against a ticking clock.

chapters.title: Encore: Loudest Girl in Lake Minnow
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. At the spring festival, with the demolition crew arriving Monday, Odile hijacks the stage sound system to play the Mixtape's final track—the victims' names read aloud over the archived recordings. The town turns on the board; Theo is pulled from the contaminated creek just in time. The beat is costly triumph: seen at last, and unable to go back.
